subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
skillName: How Pushes and Pulls Move Things
intro: A push or a pull is a force that can make things move. A push moves an object away from you, and a pull moves it toward you. A bigger, stronger push or pull can make an object move faster or farther than a small one. The direction you push or pull also changes which way the object goes. By trying different pushes and pulls on the same object, we can compare how strength and direction change its motion.

items.prompt: You give a toy car a soft push and then a hard push. Which push makes the car go farther, and why?

steps: A push is a force that moves the car.
A harder push gives the car more force to move.
So the hard push makes the car go farther than the soft push.
solution.answer: The hard push makes the car go farther, because a stronger push moves it more.

items.prompt: A ball is pushed to the left and then to the right. What does the direction of the push change?

steps: A push moves an object in the direction of the push.
Pushing left sends the ball left, and pushing right sends it right.
So the direction of the push changes the direction the ball moves.
solution.answer: The direction of the push changes which way the ball moves: left or right.

items.prompt: You want a swing to go higher. Should you push it harder or softer?

steps: A harder push gives the swing more force.
More force makes the swing move more.
So pushing harder makes the swing go higher.
solution.answer: Push it harder, because a stronger push makes it go higher.

items.prompt: What is a push or a pull?

steps: A push or a pull is a kind of force.
It can make an object start to move or change how it moves.
solution.answer: A force that can make things move.

items.prompt: A wagon can be pulled toward you or pushed away. Describe how each one moves the wagon.

steps: A pull moves the wagon toward you.
A push moves the wagon away from you.
So pulling brings it closer and pushing sends it away.
solution.answer: A pull brings the wagon toward you, and a push sends it away from you.

items.prompt: Plan a simple test to compare a gentle push and a strong push on a toy car.

steps: Use the same toy car each time so the test is fair.
Give it a gentle push and mark how far it goes, then a strong push and mark that.
Compare the marks to see that the strong push moves the car farther.
solution.answer: Push the same car gently, then strongly, and compare how far it goes each time.
